name: How long does a typical window opening repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window opening repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window opening repair varies significantly based on the extent of the damage and the number of openings requiring attention. Minor repairs, such as replacing a small section of rotted wood, might take a few hours to a day per window. More extensive structural repairs, involving multiple layers of framing or addressing significant water damage, could extend to several days per opening. Our team will provide a detailed timeline after an on-site assessment to give you an accurate estimate for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies by damage extent; minor fixes may take hours to a day, while extensive structural repairs could take several days per opening. An on-site assessment provides an accurate timeline.
